description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange w.e.f. 01.06.2020 to 07.06.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It is a regulatory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs, exercising powers granted by specific legislation (Section 17 of the Customs Ordinance). The content focuses on legal compliance requirements for financial transactions related to customs, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure announcement or any other specialized category.
